# IF-005 — Nightly customer export

[Landscape and catalog](../../README.md) · [Catalog source](../../catalog/catalog.json)

Transfers customer master data directly between the two external systems.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Stable interface ID | `IF-005` |
| Source | [External CRM](../systems/crm.md) (external) |
| Target | [External ERP](../systems/erp.md) (external) |
| Deployed contract version | **3.0.0** |
| Status | active |
| Protocol | SFTP / UTF-8 CSV |
| Operation / channel | Nightly /inbound/customers/customers-YYYYMMDD.csv |
| Integration owner | Customer Operations |
| Contract artifact | [CSV data dictionary — 3.0.0](../../contracts/customer-export/customer-export-3.0.0.md) |

## Authentication

Vendor-managed SFTP key; the internal platform does not hold credentials.

## Reliability and failure handling

Upload to a temporary name, then rename atomically; ERP acknowledges with a .done file. Alert on a missing daily delivery.

## Integration notes

- This connection bypasses internal components but remains part of the integration landscape.
- Customer Operations owns coordination between the two vendors.

The contract artifact is stored in this repository at a versioned path.
The deployed version is the example integration's selected contract version; it is not a measurement from a running system.
The stable interface page stays at the same path when that selected version changes.
